metadata.name: ProcessEd Intelligence Netherlands Demo Bundle
metadata.note: Sample/demo data only. Not verified live tender coverage.

opportunities.buyer_signal: Water authority capital upgrade with specialist delivery requirements.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: High-value water resilience entry opportunity for specialist contractors.
opportunities.recommended_action: Qualify M&E and civils consortium options.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample water authority works for civil, mechanical, and electrical upgrades to a wastewater pumping station.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldwerk voor civiele, mechanische en elektrische renovatie van een afvalwatergemaal.
opportunities.title: Groningen wastewater pumping station upgrade

opportunities.buyer_signal: Large municipal public works buyer with recurring waterfront asset needs.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Strong Netherlands entry proof point for urban civils and drainage-led infrastructure.
opportunities.recommended_action: Qualify civils partners with quay and drainage references.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample notice for quay wall renewal, drainage tie-ins, traffic phasing, and public realm reinstatement in Rotterdam.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldmelding voor kademuurvernieuwing, koppeling met drainage, fasering van verkeer en herstel van openbare ruimte in Rotterdam.
opportunities.title: Rotterdam quay wall renewal and drainage interface works

opportunities.buyer_signal: Large EU-facing framework likely to attract specialist international suppliers.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Signals cross-border route into Dutch water infrastructure.
opportunities.recommended_action: Identify consortium partners and review eligibility for cross-border lots.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample TED-style framework for flood resilience studies and works packages with Dutch, Belgian, and cross-border assets.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeld van TED-raamwerk voor hoogwaterbescherming met Nederlandse, Belgische en grensoverschrijdende objecten.
opportunities.title: Benelux flood resilience framework with Dutch work packages

opportunities.buyer_signal: National infrastructure buyer with complex compliance expectations.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Anchor account for serious Netherlands infrastructure market entry.
opportunities.recommended_action: Review bonding, Dutch safety certification, and geotechnical partner needs.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample national waterways package for embankment stabilisation, geotechnical design coordination, and environmental controls.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldpakket voor oeverstabilisatie, geotechnische ontwerpafstemming en milieumaatregelen langs rijkswateren.
opportunities.title: Rijkswaterstaat canal embankment stabilisation works

opportunities.buyer_signal: Maintenance-led framework with recurring operational demand.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Directly maps to drainage and maintenance wedge for specialist suppliers.
opportunities.recommended_action: Prepare drainage maintenance capability statement and local response model.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample multi-year framework for stormwater drainage cleaning, inspection, minor repairs, and incident response.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeld van meerjarig raamcontract voor reiniging, inspectie, kleine reparaties en storingsdienst voor hemelwaterafvoer.
opportunities.title: Haarlemmermeer stormwater drainage maintenance framework

opportunities.buyer_signal: Port infrastructure scope with international procurement visibility.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Relevant to contractors using ports and logistics as a Netherlands entry wedge.
opportunities.recommended_action: Monitor for Dutch port authority participation and specialist lot notices.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample cross-border port access package covering road widening, utility corridors, quay interfaces, and drainage resilience.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeld van grensoverschrijdend havenpakket voor wegverbreding, nutsstroken, kade-aansluitingen en robuuste afwatering.
opportunities.title: North Sea port access road and utility corridor improvements

opportunities.buyer_signal: Provincial asset owner bundling roads and structures maintenance.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Good fit for contractors with highways and structures capability.
opportunities.recommended_action: Check bridge repair credentials and subcontract traffic management coverage.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample road maintenance package for resurfacing, bridge deck repairs, lane closures, and asset handover data.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldpakket voor wegonderhoud, deklaagvernieuwing, brugdekreparaties, rijstrookafzettingen en overdrachtsdata.
opportunities.title: Zeeland provincial road resurfacing and bridge deck repairs

opportunities.buyer_signal: Cross-border asset owner may value suppliers with Benelux and DACH delivery references.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Connects Netherlands and DACH infrastructure sales narratives without modifying DACH artifacts.
opportunities.recommended_action: Qualify traffic management, bridge repair, and multilingual bid capacity.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample bridge maintenance and traffic management opportunity across Rhine corridor assets with Dutch market relevance.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldkans voor brugonderhoud en verkeersmanagement op Rijncorridorobjecten met relevantie voor de Nederlandse markt.
opportunities.title: Rhine corridor bridge maintenance and traffic management package

opportunities.buyer_signal: Urban mobility investment with repeat cycling infrastructure demand.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Useful for road maintenance and active-travel suppliers entering Dutch municipalities.
opportunities.recommended_action: Monitor for lotting and traffic management requirements.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample package covering cycle corridor resurfacing, junction works, kerbing, markings, and drainage adjustments.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldpakket voor herinrichting van fietscorridor, kruispuntwerk, banden, markering en aanpassing van afwatering.
opportunities.title: Utrecht cycling corridor resurfacing and junction civil works

opportunities.buyer_signal: Growing city with public realm and utility coordination demand.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Relevant to firms selling municipal civils and compact urban delivery capability.
opportunities.recommended_action: Assess utility coordination and local subcontractor requirements.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample municipal civils works covering utility diversions, paving, drainage channels, and phased public realm delivery.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeld van gemeentelijke civiele werken voor kabels en leidingen, bestrating, afwateringsgoten en gefaseerde uitvoering.
opportunities.title: Eindhoven public realm utilities relocation and pavement works

opportunities.buyer_signal: Provincial roads buyer packaging drainage with pavement lifecycle works.
opportunities.expansion_relevance: Shows regional maintenance demand beyond major cities.
opportunities.recommended_action: Track until specifications confirm drainage and surfacing lot structure.
opportunities.summary_en: Sample rural road package combining drainage improvements, verge reconstruction, culvert replacement, and surfacing.
opportunities.summary_nl: Voorbeeldpakket voor landelijk wegwerk met betere afwatering, bermherstel, vervanging van duikers en verharding.
opportunities.title: Flevoland rural road drainage and verge reconstruction

Track neighbourhood renewal, cycle infrastructure, streetscape, and drainage-linked works.
Surface quay, access road, drainage, and utility relocation opportunities for specialist contractors.
Use TED signals to identify larger packages where non-Dutch suppliers or consortia may participate.
